'''TJ-11''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] refurbished by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was tasked with capturing the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Shadow Raptor]]'' in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian Borderlands]].<ref name="DitW" />
